evidence.quote: Taught in 1st - 3rd semester: English, German language courses for A2 through B2 part of curriculum From the 4th semester: German
Fees No tuition fees, only student union fee
If you are interested in applying to our university, choose what you aim to study and apply directly to DIT via our own online application portal, Primuss.

notes: Teaching languages: English for first three semesters, German from the fourth semester. Tuition: no tuition fees per the programme page, but non-EU/EEA students pay a service fee of EUR 500 per semester and a EUR 60 application fee. Duration 8 semesters (4 years). Application deadline: the programme page states '15 October - 1 December', which likely refers to the summer semester intake, but the year is not specified, so application deadline is left null.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre baccalauréat marocain est reconnu comme qualification d'entrée à l'université via la base de données DAAD ou Anabin. Un test d'admission en ligne (mathématiques) est requis.
note.en: Check whether your Moroccan Baccalaureate is recognised as a university entrance qualification via the DAAD database or Anabin. An online admission test (mathematics) is required.

evidence.quote: General German university entrance qualification For all applications received from 1 October to 1 December, the online admission test takes place shortly after the end of the application period.
